VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the proration logic and run 37 tests successfully, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 37 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof beyond self-attestation. Self-reports are the weakest evidence class and cannot independently satisfy acceptance criteria that require demonstrable test results.
